title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This is not a manuscript page. It is a typescript page (p. 127) of SGA 7 I, Exposé IX, Grothendieck's 'Modèles de Néron et monodromie', section 10.5 'Réduction de 10.4 à un cas particulier'. The archive stamp is 445; the neighbouring handwritten pages on divided-power de Rham material were evidently written on the backs of or interleaved with old SGA 7 typescript.

Setting: S is a trait (a discrete valuation ring) with fraction field K, and A_K is an abelian variety over K with semi-stable reduction, with dual A'_K. M and M' are the character groups of the toric parts of the Néron-model reductions of A and A'. They form lattices, étale group schemes over S. For each prime ℓ there is an ℓ-adic monodromy pairing u_ℓ : M⊗M' → Z_ℓ. Theorem 10.4 says: (a) there is an integral pairing u : M⊗M' → Z_S inducing all the u_ℓ; (b) u is non-degenerate.

10.5.1 reduces the proof as follows.
- Uniqueness of u is clear, even for one ℓ.
- Existence amounts to two things: each u_ℓ already lands in Z, and the resulting map is independent of ℓ. It suffices to do this rationally, with u_Q : M_Q⊗M'_Q → Q_S.
- Under a base change S'→S of ramification index e = e(S'/S), as in 9.3, the monodromy pairing is multiplied by e (formula 10.3.5). So existence over S' gives a pairing u with values in (1/e)Z_S ⊂ Q_S, compatible with all the u_ℓ⊗Q_ℓ. Integrality at each ℓ then gives (a).
- Non-degeneracy (b) descends trivially from K' to K.
- Hence one may make any dominant change of traits, for instance pass to a complete S with algebraically closed residue field. Then M and M' are constant, with values free Z-modules of finite type.

10.5.2 begins the second reduction. If A_K is a direct factor of a semi-stable abelian scheme Ā_K for which 10.4 holds, then 10.4 holds for A_K. This uses the evident functoriality of the lattices and of the monodromy pairings under direct sums. In SGA 7 the intended Ā_K is a Jacobian, treated in §§11–12 through intersection matrices on the special fibre of a semi-stable curve model.
errors: The image reads 'schéma abélien Ā_K sur k'; it should be 'sur K' (the fraction field). This is a typographical slip in the typescript.

Passing from (1/e)Z-values to Z-values needs integrality at every prime dividing e, including possibly the residue characteristic p. SGA 7 IX handles this because the pairings are defined for ℓ = p as well, via Néron models and finite flat group schemes. The page itself does not spell this out.
